jobs.title: Research Team Manager - Switching (80 -100%) All genders
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Department Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities


In this role reporting to the Research Department Manager, you will supervise research towards development of new switchgear solutions for the broad ABB product portfolio in a dedicated research team. The group covers multiple aspects of switching, from plasma physics to new current interruption technologies) and has deep expertise in experimental methods, physical modelling, and simulations.

Additional to identification and development of innovative switching solutions, the team supports technology implementation in ABB factories worldwide. The goal is to ensure technology leadership of ABB products, while strongly focusing on sustainable and cost-efficient solutions without compromises on performance.


The work model for the role is: hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for

  • Managing a research group with 8-10 employees and contributing to a motivating and innovative working climate as well as coaching project leaders for scientific excellence and professional execution of R&D projects. You will also manage the group’s laboratory infrastructure and control of workplace safety.
  • Planning and ensuring an optimal project portfolio for the team, focusing on a balanced long-term pipeline of low and high TRL activities
  • Recommending, developing, and improving processes and procedures to enhance local operations in addition to carrying out own research projects
  • Overseeing and assisting with transfer of technology and knowledge between internal partners and closely collaborating with Business Area Research Managers while maintaining and extending network to relevant ABB Divisions as well as Product and Technology Management



• Qualifications for the role


  • MSc/PhD in physics or engineering with a scientific background
  • Several years of relevant experience in industrial R&D and research project management
  • Communication skills and interest in lively interaction within an interdisciplinary team
  • Interest in new fields of research and technology, and in people management
  • Fluency in English and willingness to learn German



More about us

The ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, is where we investigate new technologies which support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.


We look forward to receiving your application, including CV, cover letter and list of publications. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

ABB Data Privacy Statement: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate


We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung


In dieser Funktion betreuen Sie die Forschung zur Entwicklung neuer Schaltanlagenlösungen für das breite ABB-Produktportfolio in einem dedizierten Forschungsteam. Die Gruppe deckt mehrere Aspekte des Schaltens ab, von der Plasmaphysik bis hin zu neuen aktuellen Unterbrechungstechnologien und verfügt über umfassendes Fachwissen in experimentellen Methoden, physikalischer Modellierung und Simulationen.

Neben der Identifizierung und Entwicklung innovativer Schaltlösungen unterstützt das Team die Technologieimplementierung in ABB-Fabriken weltweit. Ziel ist es, die Technologieführerschaft von ABB-Produkten zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig einen starken Fokus auf nachhaltige und kosteneffiziente Lösungen ohne Kompromisse bei der Leistung zu legen.


Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid


Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für

  • Leitung einer Forschungsgruppe mit 8-10 Mitarbeitern und Beitrag zu einem motivierenden und innovativen Arbeitsklima sowie Coaching von Projektleitern für wissenschaftliche Exzellenz und professionelle Durchführung von F&E-Projekten. Sie werden auch die Laborinfrastruktur der Gruppe und die Kontrolle der Arbeitsplatzsicherheit verwalten.
  • Planung und Sicherstellung eines optimalen Projektportfolios für das Team mit Fokus auf eine ausgewogene langfristige Pipeline von niedrigen und hohen TRL-Aktivitäten
  • Empfehlen, Entwickeln und Verbessern von Prozessen und Verfahren zur Verbesserung lokaler Operationen zusätzlich zur Durchführung eigener Forschungsprojekte
  • Überwachung und Unterstützung des Technologie- und Wissenstransfers zwischen internen Partnern und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Business Area Research Managern bei der Pflege und Erweiterung des Netzwerks zu relevanten ABB Divisionen sowie Produkt- und Technologiemanagement



• Qualifikationen für die Rolle


  • MSc/PhD in Physik oder Ingenieurwissenschaften mit wissenschaftlichem Hintergrund
  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Erfahrung im industriellen F&E- und Forschungsprojektmanagement
  • Kommunikationskompetenz und Interesse an lebendiger Interaktion innerhalb eines interdisziplinären Teams
  • Interesse an neuen Forschungs- und Technologiefeldern sowie am People Management
  • Fluency in English and willing to learn German


    • Mehr über uns

    Das ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil, Schweiz, untersucht neue Technologien, die die Entwicklung der Produkte und Lösungen der nächsten Generation von ABB unterstützen und vorantreiben. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems und Switching.


    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich Lebenslauf, Anschreiben und Publikationsliste. Wenn Sie mehr über ABB erfahren möchten, werfen Sie einen weiteren Blick auf unsere Website www.abb.com.

    ABB Datenschutzerklärung: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate


    Wir schätzen Menschen mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund. Könnte das deine Geschichte sein? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie www.abb.com, um mehr über uns zu erfahren und mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

    Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

    Ready to make a impact?

    Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

R&D Chef de département

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités


Dans le cadre de ce rôle qui relève du responsable du département de recherche, vous superviserez la recherche vers le développement de nouvelles solutions de switchgear pour le large portefeuille de produits ABB dans une équipe de recherche dédiée. Le groupe couvre plusieurs aspects du passage de la physique du plasma aux nouvelles technologies d'interruption actuelles et possède une expertise approfondie en méthodes expérimentales, en modélisation physique et en simulations.

En plus de l'identification et du développement de solutions de commutation novatrices, l'équipe appuie la mise en oeuvre de la technologie dans les usines ABB du monde entier. L'objectif est d'assurer le leadership technologique des produits ABB, tout en mettant fortement l'accent sur des solutions durables et rentables sans compromis sur la performance.


Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride


Vous serez principalement responsable de

  • Gestion d'un groupe de recherche composé de 8 à 10 employés et contribution à un climat de travail stimulant et innovateur, ainsi qu'encadrement des chefs de projet pour l'excellence scientifique et l'exécution professionnelle de projets de R-D. Vous gérerez également l'infrastructure de laboratoire du groupe et le contrôle de la sécurité au travail.
  • Planifier et assurer un portefeuille de projets optimal pour l'équipe, en mettant l'accent sur un pipeline équilibré à long terme d'activités de LRT faibles et élevées
  • Recommander, élaborer et améliorer les processus et les procédures pour améliorer les opérations locales en plus d'exécuter ses propres projets de recherche
  • Superviser et aider le transfert de technologie et de connaissances entre les partenaires internes et collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de la recherche du secteur d'activité tout en maintenant et en étendant le réseau aux divisions pertinentes de l'ABB ainsi qu'à la gestion des produits et de la technologie


• Qualifications pour le rôle


  • MSc/PhD en physique ou en génie ayant une formation scientifique
  • Plusieurs années d'expérience pertinente en R-D industrielle et en gestion de projets de recherche
  • Capacités de communication et intérêt pour une interaction active au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire
  • Intérêt pour les nouveaux domaines de la recherche et de la technologie, et pour la gestion des personnes
  • Fluence en anglais et volonté d'apprendre l'allemand



Plus d'informations sur nous

Le Centre de recherche ABB situé à Baden-Dättwil, en Suisse, est l'endroit où nous étudions les nouvelles technologies qui soutiennent et stimulent le développement de produits et de solutions de nouvelle génération d'ABB. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique électrique, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutation.


Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris un CV, une lettre de motivation et une liste de publications. Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur ABB, consultez notre site Web www.abb.com.

Déclaration de confidentialité des données de l'ABB : https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate


Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons. Ça pourrait être votre histoire ? Postulez aujourd'hui ou visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et découvrez l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêts à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Ingénieur commercial - Tableaux électriques (80-100)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

EL Product Marketing Manager

__

Your Role

In this dynamic sales position, you will contribute to market development with panel manufacturers in French-speaking Switzerland. You will identify market opportunities, build strong customer relationships and successfully position our solutions in the field of power distribution. In close cooperation with internal teams, business partners and stakeholders, you will contribute directly to the sustainable growth of the company.


Working Model: Hybrid

This position is part of the electrification and smart power department in Baden. The workplace is Morges.


• Your responsibilities

  • You will achieve your business goals by identifying new market opportunities, building a sustainable sales pipeline in Salesforce, and developing targeted sales strategies
  • You will attract and develop new customers by demonstrating the benefits of ABB solutions and demonstrating exemplary professionalism in the sales process, communication and follow-up process.
  • You maintain long-term partnerships with your customers through early identification of needs, expert advice and excellent service throughout the entire sales cycle
  • You will support customer projects from the discovery of the opportunity to its successful completion, developing customized technical and commercial solutions in collaboration with internal teams and partners
  • You will coordinate all relevant stakeholders and ensure professional sales processes through clear communication on delivery times, general terms and conditions and contract clauses

• Requirements

  • Several years of successful experience in technical sales or project sales, ideally in the areas of electrical distributors, power distribution or building management, with convincing results
  • Technical experience and relevant education or training in the field of electrical engineering and electrical distribution
  • Ability to manage complex sales processes and communicate effectively with decision-makers at all levels
  • The proven ability to build long-term relationships with customers through a partnership-based approach
  • Expertise in strategic consulting on business models, market positioning and differentiation arguments
  • A person who can work in a team, has professional communication skills and a cross-departmental mindset
  • Language skills: French (native), fluency in other languages is an advantage. Valid category B driver's license and valid Swiss work permit

Benefits

• We offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA cheques
  • Rabatte (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Advantageous parental leave
  • Financial support for fitness
  • Company car

Learn more about us

ABB Smart Buildings improves the energy efficiency, safety and comfort of all building types through innovative digital technologies and integrated solutions. We support a wide range of markets, from residential to industrial facilities, with scalable solutions that deliver both sustainable and financial benefits while supporting carbon reduction strategies.

Recruitment is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner, ABB Schweiz AG.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a gestire più snelle e più pulite.E ogni persona qui fa accadere questo. Avrete il potere di guidare, supportato per crescere e orgogliosi dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gira nel mondo.

This position reports to:

EL Product Marketing Manager

Your Role

In questa posizione dinamica di vendita, contribuirete allo sviluppo del mercato con i produttori di pannelli in Svizzera francofonde. Potrete identificare le opportunità di mercato, costruire relazioni con i clienti forti e posizionare con successo le nostre soluzioni nel campo della distribuzione di energia. In stretta collaborazione con team interni, partner commerciali e stakeholder, contribuirete direttamente alla crescita sostenibile dell'azienda.


Modello di lavoro: Hybrid

Questa posizione fa parte del dipartimento di elettrificazione e smart power nel Baden. Il posto di lavoro è Morges.


• Le vostre responsabilità

  • Raggiungete i vostri obiettivi di business individuando nuove opportunità di mercato, costruendo un gasdotto di vendita sostenibile in Salesforce e sviluppando strategie di vendita mirate
  • Attraete e svilupperete nuovi clienti dimostrando i vantaggi delle soluzioni ABB e dimostrando una professionalità esemplare nel processo di vendita, comunicazione e follow-up.
  • Conservate partnership a lungo termine con i vostri clienti attraverso l'individuazione precoce delle esigenze, la consulenza di esperti e un servizio eccellente Per tutto il ciclo di vendita
  • Sosterrai i progetti dei clienti dalla scoperta dell'opportunità al suo completamento riuscito, sviluppando soluzioni tecniche e commerciali personalizzate in collaborazione con team interni e partner
  • >Tu coordinerai tutti i soggetti interessati e assicurerai processi di vendita professionali attraverso una chiara comunicazione sui tempi di consegna, condizioni generali e clausole contrattuali

• Requisiti

  • Più anni di esperienza di successo nelle vendite tecniche o di progetto, idealmente nei settori della vendita di progetti distributori elettrici, distribuzione di energia elettrica o gestione di edifici, con risultati convincenti
  • Esperienza tecnica e formazione pertinente nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica e della distribuzione elettrica
  • Capacità di gestire processi di vendita complessi e comunicare efficacemente con i decisori a tutti i livelli
  • La comprovata capacità di costruire relazioni a lungo termine con i clienti attraverso un approccio basato sulla partnership
  • Espertizzare in consulenza strategica su modelli aziendali, posizionamento sul mercato e argomenti di differenziazione
  • Una persona che può lavorare in un team, ha capacità di comunicazione professionale e una mentalità trasversale
  • Language: francese (nativo), fluenza in altre lingue è un vantaggio. La patente di guida di categoria B e il permesso di lavoro svizzero validi

Benefits

• Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti i seguenti vantaggi:

  • Piano di proprietà del personale (ESAP)
  • Reka cheques
  • Rabate (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Advantageous parental leave
  • Company car

Learn more about us

Sosteniamo un'ampia gamma di mercati, dalle strutture residenziali alle industriali, con soluzioni di scalabilità che offrono vantaggi sia sostenibili che finanziari, sostenendo strategie di riduzione del carbonio.

Il reclutamento è guidato da Reto Kortick, Partner di Total, ABB Schweiz AG.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Per questo accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni background ed esperienza.

Ready per fare un impatto?

Applicare oggi o visitare https://www.abb.comper saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Abb helfen wir der Industrie, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder hier macht das möglich. Sie werden befähigt, zu führen, unterstützt, um zu wachsen, und sind stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam erzielen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, das zu regieren, was die Welt regiert

Diese Position berichtet an:

EL Product Marketing Manager

__

Ihre Rolle

In dieser dynamischen Vertriebsposition tragen Sie zur Marktentwicklung mit Panelherstellern in der Westschweiz bei. Sie erkennen Marktchancen, bauen starke Kundenbeziehungen auf und positionieren unsere Lösungen erfolgreich im Bereich der Energieverteilung. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams, Geschäftspartnern und Stakeholdern tragen Sie direkt zum nachhaltigen Wachstum des Unternehmens bei.


Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid

Diese Position ist Teil der Abteilung Elektrifizierung und Smart Power in Baden. Der Arbeitsplatz ist Morges.


• Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Sie erreichen Ihre Geschäftsziele, indem Sie neue Marktchancen identifizieren, eine nachhaltige Vertriebspipeline in Salesforce aufbauen und gezielte Vertriebsstrategien entwickeln
  • Sie gewinnen und entwickeln neue Kunden, indem Sie die Vorteile von ABB-Lösungen aufzeigen und beispielhafte Professionalität im Verkaufsprozess, in der Kommunikation und im Folgeprozess demonstrieren.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Senior Engineering Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead technical expertise assignments of high complexity within the area of Drive Applications. Each day, you will contribute to advancing our electric drive solutions and services for heavy-duty minerals processing equipment—such as mills, high-pressure grinding rolls, conveyors, fans, and pumps—while helping shape our technical strategy.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Industries division in Switzerland (located in Baden-City). Main stakeholders are R&D, Product Management, the Quality department, suppliers, and engineering teams.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Driving solution advancement: Collaborating closely with R&D and Product Management to co-develop next-generation drive solutions, define technical standards, and translate field insights into product improvements.
  • Leading L3/L4 escalation and RCA: Acting as the senior technical authority by leading complex troubleshooting, systematic root cause analysis (RCA), and critical issue resolution.
  • Managing supplier and quality interfaces: Partnering with the Quality department and key suppliers to investigate component failures, validate corrective actions, and ensure long-term system reliability.
  • Developing team competency: Elevating technical expertise across the engineering team by mentoring colleagues, identifying training needs, and sharing specialized knowledge.

Our team dynamics
You will join a highly motivated, collaborative, and innovative team, where you will be able to thrive and make a lasting technical impact.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Educational background: You hold a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical or Automation Engineering with a strong emphasis on Power Electronics and Drive Technology.
  • Deep domain expertise: You have 10+ years of experience working with electric drive systems and power electronics—ideally within heavy industries or minerals processing.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills: You possess a proven track record in L3/L4 technical support, complex system diagnostics, and structured root cause analysis (RCA) across hardware, software, and application interfaces.
  • Cross-functional and supplier collaboration: You are highly adept at working across R&D, Product Management, Quality, and external component suppliers to resolve technical bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Mentorship and innovation mindset: You are passionate about coaching colleagues, sharing knowledge, and translating complex technical challenges into scalable engineering solutions.
  • Communication and flexibility: You are at ease communicating in English at an advanced technical level (written and spoken) and are willing to travel occasionally (approx. 10–20%) to customer sites or suppliers for critical escalations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a operare in modo più efficiente e sostenibile—e ogni persona qui contribuisce a renderlo possibile. Avrai l'autonomia per guidare, il supporto per crescere e potrai essere orgoglioso/a dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiutaci a far funzionare ciò che fa funzionare il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Responsabile senior dell'ingegneria

__

In questo ruolo, avrai l'opportunità di guidare attività tecniche di elevata complessità nell'ambito delle applicazioni per azionamenti. Ogni giorno contribuirai a far progredire le nostre soluzioni e i nostri servizi per azionamenti elettrici destinati ad apparecchiature per la lavorazione di minerali per impieghi gravosi—come mulini, rulli di macinazione ad alta pressione, trasportatori, ventilatori e pompe—contribuendo al contempo a definire la nostra strategia tecnica.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: #LI-Hybrid

Questo ruolo rientra nella divisione Process Industries in Svizzera (con sede a Baden-City). I principali interlocutori sono R&S, Gestione del prodotto, il dipartimento Qualità, i fornitori e i team di ingegneria.

Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

- Far progredire le soluzioni: Collaborare a stretto contatto con R&S e Gestione del prodotto per sviluppare congiuntamente soluzioni di azionamento di nuova generazione, definire standard tecnici e trasformare le informazioni raccolte sul campo in miglioramenti dei prodotti.

- Gestire le escalation L3/L4 e l'RCA: Agire in qualità di massima autorità tecnica, guidando attività complesse di risoluzione dei problemi, analisi sistematica delle cause radice (RCA) e risoluzione di problemi critici.

- Gestire le interfacce con i fornitori e la Qualità: Collaborare con il dipartimento Qualità e i fornitori chiave per indagare sui guasti dei componenti, convalidare le azioni correttive e garantire l'affidabilità del sistema a lungo termine.

- Sviluppare le competenze del team: Accrescere le competenze tecniche all'interno del team di ingegneria facendo da mentore ai colleghi, individuando le esigenze formative e condividendo conoscenze specialistiche.

Le dinamiche del nostro team
Entrerai a far parte di un team altamente motivato, collaborativo e innovativo, in cui potrai esprimere il tuo potenziale e generare un impatto tecnico duraturo.

• Requisiti per il ruolo:

- Formazione: possiedi una B.Sc. o una M.Sc. in Ingegneria elettrica o dell'automazione, con una forte focalizzazione sull'elettronica di potenza e sulla tecnologia degli azionamenti.

- Profonda competenza nel settore: hai 10+ anni di esperienza nel lavoro con sistemi di azionamento elettrico ed elettronica di potenza—idealmente in industrie pesanti o nella lavorazione dei minerali.

- Competenze avanzate nella risoluzione dei problemi: possiedi una comprovata esperienza nel supporto tecnico L3/L4, nella diagnostica di sistemi complessi e nell'analisi strutturata delle cause radice (RCA) tra interfacce hardware, software e applicative.

- Collaborazione interfunzionale e con i fornitori: hai una spiccata capacità di lavorare con R&S, Gestione del prodotto, Qualità e fornitori esterni di componenti per risolvere i colli di bottiglia tecnici e promuovere il miglioramento continuo.

- Mentalità orientata al mentoring e all'innovazione: ti appassiona affiancare i colleghi, condividere le conoscenze e trasformare complesse sfide tecniche in soluzioni ingegneristiche scalabili.

- Comunicazione e flessibilità: sei a tuo agio nel comunicare in inglese a un livello tecnico avanzato (scritto e parlato) e sei disponibile a viaggiare occasionalmente (circa 10–20%) presso le sedi dei clienti o dei fornitori per gestire escalation critiche.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede menti di ogni tipo: quelle curiose, coraggiose e creative. Per questo accogliamo persone di ogni provenienza e con ogni tipo di esperienza.

Pronto/a a fare la differenza?

Candidati oggi stesso o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

- Vorantreiben der Lösungsentwicklung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit R&D und dem Produktmanagement, um Antriebslösungen der nächsten Generation gemeinsam zu entwickeln, technische Standards zu definieren und Erkenntnisse aus dem Feld in Produktverbesserungen zu überführen.

Sie werden Teil eines hochmotivierten, kooperativen und innovativen Teams, in dem Sie sich entfalten und nachhaltig technische Wirkung erzielen können.

- Ausbildung: Sie verfügen über einen B.Sc. oder M.Sc. in Elektrotechnik oder Automatisierungstechnik mit einer starken Ausrichtung auf Leistungselektronik und Antriebstechnik.

- Tiefgehende Fachkompetenz: Sie verfügen über 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit elektrischen Antriebssystemen und Leistungselektronik – idealerweise in der Schwerindustrie oder Mineralienverarbeitung.

- Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der Fehlerbehebung: Sie verfügen über eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im technischen L3/L4-Support, in der komplexen Systemdiagnose und in der strukturierten Ursachenanalyse (RCA) über Hardware-, Software- und Anwendungsschnittstellen hinweg.

- Expertise approfondie du domaine : Vous avez 10+ ans d’expérience dans les systèmes d’entraînement électriques et l’électronique de puissance — idéalement dans les industries lourdes ou le traitement des minerais.

jobs.title: Datacenter Senior Automation & Control Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Lead Power Systems Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are looking for a Datacenter Senior Automation & Control Engineer to join our Direct Current Data Center Incubator, playing a critical role in driving the transformational shift toward next-generation Direct current data center architectures. Working closely with strategic customers—especially hyperscalers—you will help shape the future of data center architectures by translating complex customer challenges into innovative, optimized electrical solutions.


In this highly visible role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor across the full project lifecycle, combining deep technical expertise with strong consultative skills. You will influence market opportunities, support customer adoption, reduce churn, and enable flawless execution of pioneering Direct Current data center projects.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This position reports to the DC Solutions Leader in the Solid State Transformer Program.

You will be mainly accountable for:


  • In collaboration with ABB data center segment and account managers partners closely with key customers—particularly hyperscalers—to support their transition from conventional AC data centers to advanced Direct Current data center architectures.
  • Design and engineer end-to-end electrical power system solutions for data centers, delivering competitive, scalable, and future-ready system architectures.

Avrai la possibilità di guidare, il supporto per crescere e l'orgoglio per l'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e contribuisci a far funzionare ciò che fa funzionare il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Architetto principale dei sistemi di potenza

__

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

Cerchiamo un/una ingegnere senior per l'automazione e il controllo dei data center per entrare a far parte del nostro Incubatore di data center a corrente continua, svolgendo un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere la trasformazione verso architetture di data center a corrente continua di nuova generazione. Lavorando a stretto contatto con clienti strategici—soprattutto hyperscaler—contribuirai a plasmare il futuro delle architetture dei data center traducendo le complesse sfide dei clienti in soluzioni elettriche innovative e ottimizzate.

In questo ruolo di grande visibilità, agirai in qualità di consulente tecnico di fiducia durante l'intero ciclo di vita del progetto, combinando una profonda competenza tecnica con solide capacità consulenziali. Influencerai le opportunità di mercato, sosterrai l'adozione da parte dei clienti, ridurrai il tasso di abbandono e consentirai l'esecuzione impeccabile di progetti pionieristici di data center a corrente continua.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido

Questa posizione riporta al Responsabile delle soluzioni in corrente continua nel Programma dei trasformatori a stato solido.

Sarai principalmente responsabile di :

- In collaborazione con il segmento data center di ABB e con gli account manager, collaborerai a stretto contatto con i clienti chiave—in particolare gli hyperscaler—per supportare la loro transizione dai data center convenzionali in corrente alternata alle architetture avanzate di data center a corrente continua.

- Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni complete per i sistemi di alimentazione elettrica dei data center, fornendo architetture di sistema competitive, scalabili e pronte per il futuro.

- Progettare i sistemi di controllo dell'automazione— Progettando schemi di protezione specifici per la corrente continua e schemi di controllo complessivi per l'architettura futura, inclusi la sequenza operativa, la gestione del carico e il monitoraggio attivo.

- Supportare i progetti pilota, garantendo la completezza della soluzione tecnica e della documentazione necessarie per la realizzazione con successo di soluzioni innovative per data center a corrente continua.

• Requisiti per il ruolo

- Istruzione: laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria elettrica e/o dell'automazione o in una disciplina correlata

- Esperienza: 5+ anni di esperienza nella progettazione di sistemi di potenza, nella consulenza o nell'architettura di soluzioni

- Solida esperienza nei sistemi di potenza dei data center o conoscenza di soluzioni di alimentazione in corrente continua (l'esperienza in settori affini, come i sistemi marini o industriali a corrente continua, è fortemente apprezzata)

- Comprovata esperienza nella realizzazione di soluzioni tecniche complesse e ad alto impatto

- Conoscenza dei sistemi elettrici di potenza, tra cui quadri elettrici, trasformatori, sistemi di protezione e controllo.

- Capacità di operare efficacemente in ambienti tecnici in evoluzione

- Disponibilità a viaggiare a livello internazionale, in particolare negli Stati Uniti

Maggiori informazioni su di noi

La Divisione Distribution Solutions di ABB facilita la distribuzione, la protezione e il controllo efficienti e affidabili dell'energia, migliorando la qualità dell'energia elettrica e rafforzando al contempo la resilienza della rete. La Divisione offre prodotti e soluzioni specifici per settore che servono principalmente i settori delle utility, dell'industria e delle infrastrutture, fornendo spesso il necessario collegamento in media tensione tra i sistemi di trasmissione ad alta tensione e gli utenti a bassa tensione. Con le soluzioni connesse abilitate da ABB Ability™ al centro della propria offerta, l'offerta comprende quadri di media tensione isolati in aria e in gas (da 1 a 66 kilovolt), interruttori automatici per installazioni interne ed esterne, richiusori, fusibili, contattori, relè, trasformatori di misura, sensori, centri di controllo motori, nonché quadri di bassa tensione per i mercati che adottano lo standard ANSI.

Il processo di selezione è guidato da Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e più intelligente richiede menti di ogni tipo: curiose, coraggiose e creative. Ecco perché accogliamo persone di ogni provenienza e con esperienze diverse.

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien dabei, effizienter und sauberer zu arbeiten—und jede Person hier trägt dazu bei. Sie werden dazu befähigt, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, bei Ihrer Weiterentwicklung unterstützt und können stolz auf die Wirkung sein, die wir gemeinsam erzielen. Kommen Sie zu uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu betreiben, was die Welt am Laufen hält.

Diese Position berichtet an:
Leitende/r Architekt/in für Stromversorgungssysteme

__

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Wir suchen eine Person als Senior-Ingenieur/in für Automatisierungs- und Regelungstechnik im Rechenzentrumsbereich, die unserem Inkubator für Gleichstrom-Rechenzentren beitritt und eine entscheidende Rolle dabei übernimmt, den grundlegenden Wandel hin zu Gleichstrom-Rechenzentrumsarchitekturen der nächsten Generation voranzutreiben. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit strategischen Kunden—insbesondere Hyperscalern—gestalten Sie die Zukunft von Rechenzentrumsarchitekturen mit, indem Sie komplexe Kundenherausforderungen in innovative, optimierte elektrische Lösungen übersetzen.

In dieser äußerst sichtbaren Rolle sind Sie über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg als vertrauenswürdige technische Ansprechperson tätig und verbinden tiefgehende technische Expertise mit ausgeprägter Beratungskompetenz. Sie gestalten Marktchancen mit, fördern die Akzeptanz bei Kunden, reduzieren die Kundenabwanderung und ermöglichen die fehlerfreie Umsetzung wegweisender Gleichstrom-Rechenzentrumsprojekte.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid

Diese Position berichtet an die Leitung für DC-Lösungen im Programm für Festkörpertransformatoren.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

- In Zusammenarbeit mit dem ABB-Rechenzentrumssegment und den Account-Managern arbeiten Sie eng mit Schlüsselkunden—insbesondere Hyperscalern—zusammen, um deren Übergang von herkömmlichen AC-Rechenzentren zu fortschrittlichen Gleichstrom-Rechenzentrumsarchitekturen zu unterstützen.

- Konzipieren und entwickeln Sie durchgängige Lösungen für die elektrische Energieversorgung von Rechenzentren und liefern Sie wettbewerbsfähige, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Systemarchitekturen.

- Steuerung der Designautomatisierung— Entwicklung spezifischer Gleichstrom-Schutzkonzepte und übergreifender Steuerungskonzepte für die künftige Architektur, einschließlich Betriebsablauf, Lastmanagement und aktiver Überwachung.

- Unterstützen Sie Pilotprojekte und stellen Sie die Vollständigkeit der technischen Lösung und der für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung neuartiger Gleichstrom-Rechenzentrumslösungen erforderlichen Dokumentation sicher.

• Qualifikationen für die Position

- Ausbildung: Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Elektrotechnik und/oder Regelungstechnik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

- Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Planung von Stromversorgungssystemen, der Beratung oder der Lösungsarchitektur

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Stromversorgungssystemen von Rechenzentren oder Erfahrungen mit Gleichstromversorgungslösungen (Erfahrung in angrenzenden Branchen, beispielsweise mit maritimen oder industriellen Gleichstromsystemen, wird sehr geschätzt)

- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung komplexer technischer Lösungen mit großer Wirkung

- Kenntnisse in elektrischen Stromversorgungssystemen, einschließlich Schaltanlagen, Transformatoren, Schutz- und Steuerungssystemen.

- Fähigkeit, in sich weiterentwickelnden technischen Umgebungen effektiv zu arbeiten

- Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen, insbesondere in die Vereinigten Staaten

Mehr über uns

Die Division Distribution Solutions von ABB ermöglicht die effiziente und zuverlässige Verteilung, den Schutz und die Steuerung elektrischer Energie, indem sie die Qualität der elektrischen Energie verbessert und gleichzeitig die Widerstandsfähigkeit des Netzes stärkt. Die Division bietet segmentspezifische Produkte und Lösungen an, die hauptsächlich die Bereiche Versorgungsunternehmen, Industrie und Infrastruktur bedienen und häufig die erforderliche Mittelspannungsverbindung zwischen Hochspannungsübertragungssystemen und Niederspannungsnutzern bereitstellen. Das Angebot, in dessen Mittelpunkt vernetzte Lösungen mit ABB Ability™ stehen, umfasst luft- und gasisolierte Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen (1 bis 66 Kilovolt), Innenraum- und Freiluft-Leistungsschalter, Wiedereinschalter, Sicherungen, Schütze, Relais, Messwandler, Sensoren, Motorsteuerzentralen sowie Niederspannungsschaltanlagen für Märkte mit ANSI-Standards.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Gema de Vicente, Talent-Partnerin bei ABB Switzerland Ltd., geleitet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Denkweisen: die Neugierigen, die Mutigen und die Kreativen. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Sind Sie bereit, etwas zu bewirken?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Wirkung unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à faire fonctionner ce qui fait tourner le monde.

Ce poste relève de :
Architecte principal des systèmes électriques

__

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Nous recherchons un ingénieur senior en automatisation et contrôle des centres de données pour rejoindre notre incubateur de centres de données à courant continu, où vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en pilotant la transformation vers des architectures de centres de données à courant continu de nouvelle génération. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des clients stratégiques — en particulier les hyperscalers —, vous contribuerez à façonner l’avenir des architectures de centres de données en traduisant les problématiques complexes des clients en solutions électriques innovantes et optimisées.

Dans ce rôle très visible, vous agirez en tant que conseiller technique de confiance tout au long du cycle de vie des projets, en combinant une expertise technique approfondie et de solides compétences de conseil. Vous influerez sur les opportunités du marché, favoriserez l’adoption par les clients, réduirez l’attrition et permettrez la réalisation sans faille de projets pionniers de centres de données à courant continu.

Le mode de travail pour ce poste est : hybride

Ce poste relève du responsable des solutions en courant continu du programme de transformateurs à semi-conducteurs.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

- En collaboration avec le segment des centres de données d’ABB et les responsables de comptes, vous collaborerez étroitement avec des clients clés — en particulier les hyperscalers — pour accompagner leur transition des centres de données conventionnels en courant alternatif vers des architectures avancées de centres de données à courant continu.

- Concevoir et développer de bout en bout des solutions de systèmes d’alimentation électrique pour les centres de données, en fournissant des architectures de systèmes compétitives, évolutives et prêtes pour l’avenir.

- Concevoir le contrôle-commande — concevoir des schémas de protection spécifiques au courant continu et des schémas de commande globaux pour l’architecture future, y compris la séquence de fonctionnement, la gestion de la charge et la surveillance active.

- Accompagner les projets pilotes, en veillant à l’exhaustivité de la solution technique et de la documentation nécessaires à la mise en œuvre réussie de nouvelles solutions de centres de données à courant continu.

• Qualifications requises pour le poste

- Formation : diplôme de bachelor ou de master en génie électrique et/ou en contrôle-commande, ou dans une discipline connexe

- Expérience : 5+ ans d’expérience en conception de systèmes électriques, en conseil ou en architecture de solutions

- Solide expérience des systèmes d’alimentation électrique des centres de données, ou familiarité avec les solutions d’alimentation en courant continu (une expérience dans des secteurs connexes tels que les systèmes marins ou les systèmes industriels à courant continu est particulièrement appréciée)

- Expérience avérée dans la mise en œuvre de solutions techniques complexes et à fort impact

- Connaissances en systèmes électriques de puissance, notamment en appareillage électrique, transformateurs, protection et systèmes de contrôle.

- Capacité à travailler efficacement dans des environnements techniques en constante évolution

- Volonté de voyager à l’international, notamment aux États-Unis

En savoir plus sur nous

La division Distribution Solutions d'ABB facilite la distribution, la protection et le contrôle efficaces et fiables de l'électricité en améliorant la qualité de l'énergie électrique tout en renforçant la résilience du réseau. La division propose des produits et des solutions spécifiques à chaque segment qui servent principalement les secteurs des services publics, de l'industrie et des infrastructures, en fournissant souvent la liaison moyenne tension requise entre les systèmes de transport à haute tension et les utilisateurs à basse tension. Avec les solutions connectées compatibles avec ABB Ability™ en leur cœur, l'offre comprend des appareillages de commutation moyenne tension isolés dans l'air et au gaz (1 à 66 kilovolts), des disjoncteurs intérieurs et extérieurs, des réenclencheurs, des fusibles, des contacteurs, des relais, des transformateurs de mesure, des capteurs, des centres de commande de moteurs, ainsi que des appareillages basse tension pour les marchés appliquant la norme ANSI.

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Gema de Vicente, partenaire en gestion des talents, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Bâtir un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent nécessite toutes sortes de talents : les esprits curieux, courageux et créatifs. C’est pourquoi nous accueillons des personnes de tous horizons et de toutes expériences.

Envie d’avoir un impact ?

Postulez dès aujourd’hui ou rendez-vous sur https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l’impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

Global Project Execution Manager

Design authority for engineering disciplines related to complete assignments to support local units on tenders, projects or portions projects in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards and safety requirements.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

Global Project Execution Manager

Entwurfsbefugnis für Ingenieurdisziplinen im Zusammenhang mit vollständigen Aufgaben zur Unterstützung lokaler Einheiten bei Ausschreibungen, Projekten oder Teilprojekten gemäß Vertragsspezifikationen, Qualitätsstandards und Sicherheitsanforderungen.

Die Division Distribution Solutions von ABB erleichtert die effiziente und zuverlässige Verteilung, den Schutz und die Kontrolle von Energie durch die Verbesserung der Stromqualität und stärkt gleichzeitig die Widerstandsfähigkeit der Gitter. This position reports to:

Global Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will act as the focal design authority for engineering disciplines across complete assignments, supporting local units on tenders, projects, and parts of projects. You will help ensure that engineering solutions meet contract specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements, while providing technical support throughout design, testing, installation, and commissioning.


This role contributes to the Electrification Distribution Solutions Business Division and supports the EMEA region. Main stakeholders include local units, Engineering Units within Sales and Solutions Global Solutions Centers, project managers, Supply Chain, factories, and Commissioning and Service teams.


The work model for the role is #hybrid, #Li-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Providing technical support for engineering design, primary and secondary technical documentation, testing, and installation and commissioning procedures.
  • Supporting local units in preparing tender and project documentation; participating in tender and project meetings and resolving technical issues to meet contractual obligations.
  • Contributing to engineering proposals, presentations, and planning, and applying design verification checklists in line with applicable standards and engineering guidelines.
  • Ensuring engineering activities comply with safety regulations and contractual requirements; supporting technical risk assessments and following up on resulting actions.
  • Escalating contract, safety, quality, schedule, or cost issues to Project Managers, and identifying variation requests to support contract claims, subject to Project Manager approval.
  • Collaborating with Supply Chain, Project Managers, and factories to ensure technical solutions are manufactured, staged, and tested appropriately.
  • Coordinating with global Commissioning and Service teams to support correct installation and commissioning, updating engineering deliverables after site activities, and sharing lessons learned.
  • Sharing best practices and lessons learned across projects and disciplines, and identifying process or tool inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.



 • Qualifications for the role


  • You have deep knowledge of MV/LV systems and system design, including Protection and Control, Automation, and Auxiliary systems, as well as eHouse and mobile solutions.
  • You bring knowledge of MV switchgear and protection functions, and experience with switchgear engineering processes in an EPC engineering environment.
  • You are familiar with industrial communication protocols such as IEC 61850 and MODBUS, control and automation software such as ZENON, and protection relays such as the REx family and SSC 600, or similar technologies.
  • You have a sound understanding of data center applications, including hyperscale and colocation environments.
  • You have experience with commissioning activities and quality procedures for FAT and SAT.
  • You communicate effectively and have strong stakeholder-management skills, enabling collaboration across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

  • You have experience with commissioning activities and quality procedures for FAT and SAT.
  • You communicate effectively and have strong stakeholder-management skills, enabling collaboration across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als zentrale Designbehörde für technische Disziplinen in kompletten Aufgaben und unterstützen lokale Einheiten bei Ausschreibungen, Projekten und Teilen von Projekten. Sie tragen dazu bei, dass Engineering-Lösungen die Vertragsspezifikationen, Qualitätsstandards und Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen, und bieten gleichzeitig technische Unterstützung bei Entwurf, Prüfung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme.


Diese Rolle trägt zur Business Division Electrification Distribution Solutions bei und unterstützt die EMEA-Region. Zu den Hauptakteuren gehören lokale Einheiten, Engineering Units innerhalb der Sales and Solutions Global Solutions Center, Projektmanager, Supply Chain, Fabriken sowie Kommissionierungs- und Serviceteams.


Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist #hybrid, #Li-hybrid


Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Bereitstellung technischer Unterstützung für Engineering-Design, primäre und sekundäre technische Dokumentation, Prüfung und Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeverfahren.
  • Unterstützung lokaler Einheiten bei der Erstellung von Ausschreibungs- und Projektunterlagen; Teilnahme an Ausschreibungs- und Projektsitzungen und Lösung technischer Probleme zur Erfüllung vertraglicher Verpflichtungen.

  • Sie haben Erfahrung mit Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten und Qualitätsverfahren für FAT und SAT.

Vous aurez les moyens de diriger, le soutien nécessaire pour évoluer et la fierté de l’impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et contribuez à faire fonctionner ce qui fait tourner le monde.

Ce poste relève de :

Responsable mondial de l’ingénierie

__

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que référent principal en matière de conception pour les disciplines d’ingénierie dans le cadre de missions complètes, en accompagnant les unités locales dans les appels d’offres, les projets et certaines parties de projets. Vous contribuerez à garantir que les solutions d’ingénierie respectent les spécifications contractuelles, les normes de qualité et les exigences de sécurité, tout en fournissant un soutien technique tout au long de la conception, des essais, de l’installation et de la mise en service.


Cette fonction contribue à la division commerciale Electrification Distribution Solutions et soutient la région EMEA. Les principales parties prenantes sont les unités locales, les unités d’ingénierie au sein des centres mondiaux de solutions de Sales and Solutions, les chefs de projet, la chaîne d’approvisionnement, les usines ainsi que les équipes de mise en service et de service.


Le mode de travail pour ce poste est #hybrid, #Li-hybrid


Vous serez principalement responsable des éléments suivants :

  • Fournir un soutien technique pour la conception d’ingénierie, la documentation technique primaire et secondaire, les essais, ainsi que les procédures d’installation et de mise en service.
  • Soutenir les unités locales dans la préparation de la documentation relative aux appels d’offres et aux projets ; participer aux réunions d’appels d’offres et de projets et résoudre les problèmes techniques afin de respecter les obligations contractuelles.
  • Contribuer aux propositions, présentations et activités de planification d’ingénierie, et appliquer les listes de contrôle de vérification de la conception conformément aux normes applicables et aux directives d’ingénierie.
  • Veiller à ce que les activités d’ingénierie soient conformes aux règles de sécurité et aux exigences contractuelles ; contribuer aux évaluations des risques techniques et assurer le suivi des actions qui en découlent.
  • Signaler aux chefs de projet les problèmes liés au contrat, à la sécurité, à la qualité, au calendrier ou aux coûts, et identifier les demandes de modification afin d’étayer les réclamations contractuelles, sous réserve de l’approbation du chef de projet.
  • Collaborer avec la chaîne d’approvisionnement, les chefs de projet et les usines afin de garantir que les solutions techniques sont fabriquées, préparées et testées de manière appropriée.
  • Se coordonner avec les équipes mondiales de mise en service et de service afin de favoriser une installation et une mise en service correctes, mettre à jour les livrables d’ingénierie après les activités sur site et partager les enseignements tirés.
  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les enseignements tirés entre les projets et les disciplines, et identifier les inefficacités des processus ou des outils ainsi que les possibilités d’amélioration.



 • Qualifications pour le poste


  • Vous avez une connaissance approfondie des systèmes MT/BT et de la conception des systèmes, notamment en matière de protection et de contrôle, d’automatisation et de systèmes auxiliaires, ainsi que des solutions eHouse et mobiles.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Team Leader

__

In this position, you will perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure excellent customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and executing them in line with customer requirements and expectations. Through your clear and professional communication, you will contribute to customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing transparent information regarding schedules, processes, and expectations.


Work model: Field-based


This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Your key stakeholders will include customers, field service colleagues, and the internal service coordination team.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborate with customers on-site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges
  • Perform service assignments, identify technical issues, and conduct on-site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified
  • Prepare material lists for service assignments and ensure that all required materials, spare parts, and tools are available, complete, and in proper working condition
  • Provide training to field service colleagues and customers as required

Our team


You will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.



Your qualifications


  • Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electrical Planner, or a comparable technical qualification
  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage
  • Solid knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and service processes in an industrial environment
  • Strong customer focus, flexibility in adapting to changing requirements, and a solution-oriented and collaborative approach to teamwork
  • Fluent German and basic English skills for professional communication with customers
  • Willingness to travel, participate in an on-call rotation, and occasionally work weekends; primary service area: Region East, Switzerland
  • Valid driver's license for assignments within Switzerland


In dieser Position führen Sie Servicearbeiten gemäss den Arbeitsanweisungen sowie den Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien von ABB durch. Sie stellen täglich einen ausgezeichneten Kundenservice sicher, indem Sie Serviceeinsätze planen und diese entsprechend den • Anforderungen und Erwartungen der Kunden ausführen. Durch Ihre klare und professionelle Kommunikation tragen Sie zur Kundenzufriedenheit und Kundenbindung bei, indem Sie transparente Informationen zu Zeitplänen, Abläufen und Erwartungen vermitteln.


Arbeitsmodell: Aussendienst


Diese Position ist Teil der Division Electrification, Smart Power in Baden. Zu Ihren wichtigsten Ansprechpartnern gehören Kunden, Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie das interne Service-Koordinationsteam.


Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden vor Ort, um Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und bestehende Herausforderungen zu lösen
  • Durchführung von Serviceeinsätzen, Identifizierung technischer Probleme sowie Durchführung von Analysen vor Ort oder aus der Ferne innerhalb der Servicekategorien und Produktbereiche, für die Sie zertifiziert sind
  • Erstellung von Materiallisten für Serviceeinsätze und Sicherstellung, dass alle erforderlichen Materialien, Ersatzteile und Werkzeuge vollständig verfügbar und in einwandfreiem Zustand sind
  • Durchführung von Schulungen für Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Field Service sowie für Kunden nach Bedarf


Unser Team


Sie werden Teil eines kollegialen und unterstützenden Teams, in dem Sie sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln können.

• Ihre Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automatiker/in, Elektriker/in, Elektroinstallateur/in, Elektroplaner/in oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; Erfahrung mit USV-Anlagen (unterbrechungsfreie Stromversorgung) ist von Vorteil
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in elektromechanischen Systemen, Diagnosetools und Serviceprozessen im industriellen Umfeld
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, Flexibilität bei wechselnden • Anforderungen sowie eine lösungsorientierte und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kunden
  • Reisebereitschaft, Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme am Pikettdienst sowie zu gelegentlichen Wochenendeinsätzen; primäres Servicegebiet: Region Ostschweiz
  • Gültiger Führerausweis für Einsätze innerhalb der Schweiz


Benefits


• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)
  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities
  • Company vehicle and attractive fleet discounts
  • Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)
  • REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

More about us


ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, critical infrastructure, and commercial buildings. The division's technical teams work closely with industry partners to develop innovative solutions that support growth, the energy transition, and sustainability goals.

Its portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting solutions, and safety devices such as switches and relays. The Power Protection business supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced and energy-efficient UPS solutions. In addition, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable and user-friendly platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO₂ emissions.


The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Questa posizione riporta a:

Responsabile del team di assistenza

__

In questa posizione, svolgerai attività di assistenza in conformità alle istruzioni di lavoro e alle linee guida di ABB in materia di qualità e sicurezza. Garantirai ogni giorno un eccellente servizio clienti pianificando gli interventi di assistenza ed eseguendoli in linea con i requisiti e le aspettative dei clienti. Attraverso una comunicazione chiara e professionale, contribuirai alla soddisfazione e alla fidelizzazione dei clienti fornendo informazioni trasparenti su tempistiche, processi e aspettative.


Modello di lavoro: Sul campo


Questa posizione fa parte della divisione Electrification, Smart Power a Baden. I tuoi principali interlocutori includeranno clienti, colleghi dell'assistenza sul campo e il team interno di coordinamento dell'assistenza.


Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

  • Collaborare in loco con i clienti per identificare opportunità di ottimizzazione e risolvere le problematiche esistenti
  • Eseguire interventi di assistenza, identificare problemi tecnici ed effettuare analisi in loco o da remoto nell'ambito delle categorie di assistenza e delle aree di prodotto per le quali possiedi la certificazione
  • Preparare gli elenchi dei materiali per gli interventi di assistenza e assicurarti che tutti i materiali, i pezzi di ricambio e gli strumenti necessari siano disponibili, completi e in buone condizioni di funzionamento
  • Fornire formazione ai colleghi dell'assistenza sul campo e ai clienti secondo necessità

Il nostro team


Entrerai a far parte di un team collaborativo e solidale, in cui potrai continuare a crescere sia professionalmente sia personalmente.



Le tue qualifiche


  • Formazione professionale completata come tecnico dell'automazione, elettricista, installatore elettrico, progettista elettrico o qualifica tecnica comparabile
  • Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale nel campo dell'automazione, dell'ingegneria elettrica o in un settore tecnico correlato; l'esperienza con i sistemi UPS (alimentazione elettrica senza interruzioni) costituisce un vantaggio
  • Conoscenza approfondita dei sistemi elettromeccanici, degli strumenti diagnostici e dei processi di assistenza in un ambiente industriale
  • Spiccata attenzione al cliente, flessibilità nell'adattarsi alle esigenze in evoluzione e approccio al lavoro di squadra orientato alle soluzioni e collaborativo
  • Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e conoscenza di base dell'inglese per la comunicazione professionale con i clienti
  • Disponibilità a viaggiare, a partecipare a una rotazione di reperibilità e a lavorare occasionalmente nei fine settimana; area principale di assistenza: Regione Est, Svizzera
  • Patente di guida valida per gli interventi in Svizzera

  • Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale nell'automazione, nell'elettrotecnica o in un settore tecnico affine; l'esperienza con i sistemi UPS (gruppi di continuità) costituisce un vantaggio
  • Conoscenze approfondite dei sistemi elettromeccanici, degli strumenti diagnostici e dei processi di assistenza in ambito industriale
  • Spiccato orientamento al cliente, flessibilità di fronte a • requisiti variabili nonché un approccio al lavoro orientato alle soluzioni e al lavoro di squadra

  • Patente di guida valida per gli interventi in Svizzera


Vantaggi


• Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una serie di benefit interessanti, tra cui:

  • Pacchetto retributivo interessante, comprensivo di bonus, 13ª mensilità e Programma di acquisto di azioni per i dipendenti (ESAP)
  • Opportunità di formazione, sviluppo e crescita professionale

  • Contributi per abbonamenti in palestra e servizi sanitari (IFA)
  • Buoni REKA e sconti tramite Swibeco

Maggiori informazioni su di noi


ABB Smart Power fornisce soluzioni per la distribuzione dell'energia a centri dati, strutture industriali e produttive, infrastrutture critiche ed edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della divisione collaborano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore per sviluppare soluzioni innovative che favoriscano la crescita, la transizione energetica e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di sostenibilità.

Il suo portafoglio comprende interruttori automatici industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, soluzioni per l'avviamento dei motori e dispositivi di sicurezza quali interruttori e relè. La divisione Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS avanzate ed efficienti dal punto di vista energetico. Inoltre, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager offre una piattaforma scalabile e intuitiva che aiuta le organizzazioni a risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO₂.


Il processo di selezione è gestito dalla Responsabile Talent Acquisition Emma Aslani.

Per costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente servono menti di ogni tipo: curiose, coraggiose e creative. Per questo accogliamo persone di ogni provenienza e con esperienze diverse.

jobs.title: Experimental Physicist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Device Physics

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.


The work model for the role is hybrid.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of electrical power-device physics with a primary focus on Applied Thermodynamics and Thermal management; and contribute to related Multi-physics domains such as Electromagnetics and Fluid Dynamics
  • Contributing to and lead research projects supporting the ongoing energy transformation through innovative electrical power technologies and multi-physics solutions
  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments
  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications
  • Closely working with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions.


 • Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Physics or Mechanical Engineering
  • Background in the areas of Heat and Mass transfer, and Applied Thermodynamics. Knowledge of electromagnetism is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).
  • Previous experience in Project Management is essential for this role
  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes
  • Experience in multi-physics simulations, e.g., COMSOL, CFD
  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships
  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)


More about us
The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.


This recruitment process is actively managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Device Physics

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.


The work model for the role is hybrid.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of electrical power-device physics with a primary focus on Applied Thermodynamics and Thermal management; and contribute to related Multi-physics domains such as Electromagnetics and Fluid Dynamics
  • Contributing to and lead research projects supporting the ongoing energy transformation through innovative electrical power technologies and multi-physics solutions
  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments
  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications
  • Closely working with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions.


 • Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Physics or Mechanical Engineering
  • Background in the areas of Heat and Mass transfer, and Applied Thermodynamics. Knowledge of electromagnetism is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).
  • Previous experience in Project Management is essential for this role
  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes
  • Experience in multi-physics simulations, e.g., COMSOL, CFD
  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships
  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)


More about us
The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.


This recruitment process is actively managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Ce poste relève de :

Responsable de l'équipe de recherche - Physique des dispositifs de puissance

__

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de contribuer au succès d'ABB en matière de développement de technologies, de logiciels, de produits et de systèmes. Chaque jour, vous identifierez et mettrez en œuvre des solutions innovantes à des problèmes pertinents. Le mode de travail pour ce poste est hybride.


Vous aurez principalement la responsabilité de :

  • Mener des recherches appliquées dans le domaine de la physique des dispositifs de puissance électrique, en mettant principalement l'accent sur la thermodynamique appliquée et la gestion thermique ; et contribuer à des domaines multiphysiques connexes tels que l'électromagnétisme et la dynamique des fluides

 • Qualifications pour le poste

  • Doctorat en physique ou en génie mécanique
  • Expérience dans les domaines du transfert de chaleur et de masse, et de la thermodynamique appliquée. La connaissance de l’électromagnétisme est un atout (veuillez fournir une liste de publications si disponible).

  • Une expérience pratique dans un laboratoire scientifique ou industriel, la volonté de travailler de manière autonome et de prendre des initiatives pour concevoir, construire et tester des prototypes
  • Expérience en simulations multiphysiques, par exemple avec COMSOL et la CFD
  • Une approche collaborative axée sur les solutions, avec une bonne capacité à établir et à entretenir des relations de travail
  • De solides compétences en communication et en présentation en anglais (à l’écrit comme à l’oral)


En savoir plus sur nous
L’équipe de physique des dispositifs de puissance du centre de recherche d’ABB en Suisse mène des recherches interdisciplinaires axées sur les phénomènes multiphysiques liés au vaste portefeuille de dispositifs et de systèmes d’ABB, notamment les appareillages de commutation et l’électronique de puissance. L’équipe est composée de scientifiques et d’ingénieurs enthousiastes dont les activités vont de l’approfondissement des connaissances sur des phénomènes physiques tels que les claquages diélectriques dans les gaz/solides/le vide, ou la gestion thermique grâce à de nouveaux concepts de refroidissement, à la résolution de questions directement liées au portefeuille de produits d’ABB. Si les sciences et la technologie vous passionnent et que vous souhaitez travailler dans un environnement inspirant où vos compétences et vos idées s’intègrent à des solutions pour un avenir durable, postulez dès maintenant.
